recommendations.recommendation: Use phase-appropriate terminal policy and per-product note obligations on technical failure; preserve committed promises. Malformed extractor output is an explicit fault assumption.

Carry collective-date semantics independently of row cardinality. A resolved internal hesitation must not force the last sibling into an unfinished correction. Compare complete proposed terms before consent.

Clear superseded delayed refusal state when a product receives new explicit valid proposal terms. The unchanged local scenario demonstrates an earlier sibling refusal overwriting a newly agreed loan date with the old persuasion offer.

When a promise receipt already succeeded, retain receipt-backed acknowledgment and the exact required text-message sentence on failure exits; keep close outcome promise unless a successful transfer takes priority.

Extractors raw86/raw108 correctly mark c=0,a=213,d=16,u=date. dateval rejects 16 before the incomplete branch: raw93/raw115 format=1, staged_rows=[], retained p2 pending a=640.0/need amount (later amount,date); assistant M12/raw95 and M16/raw117 asks exact date. M13/raw96 ends on, extractor raw97 partial c=0,a=213,u=date; raw104 keeps old a=640.0 and unions need amount,date, prompting M14/raw106 to repeat BOTH amount and exact date despite completed amount 213. M17/raw118 supplies full p2 pair, raw119 extracts c=1, raw126 accepts 213/2026-10-16. These were genuine incomplete delivered dates, not a rejection of a complete comma date.
